adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent(...)` returns an `EventResult` object even when the underlying provider call fails (the catch returns `undefined` for `creationResult`, sets `success = false`, but the function still returns an object). The returned object now *always* includes `externalId` (passed in) and `credentialId` (`credential.id`) (see added fields in the return object). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts`, code that builds/persists booking references uses `externalCalendarId: isCalendarType ? result.externalId : undefined` and `credentialId: isCalendarType ? result.credentialId : undefined` without checking `result.success` / `result.createdEvent` before producing a reference. This can create a calendar reference containing `externalCalendarId`/`credentialId` even when no calendar event was created (i.e., `createdEvent` is `undefined`).
